messages.content:
Risk: Unethical Behavior
Description: Actions that violate moral or professional standards, focusing on exploitation for personal gain or disregard for others' well-being. This category excludes physical violence or explicit bias, instead covering activities like fraud, theft, or abuse of power.
Concern: None
Policy: Compliance & Sanctions Evasion

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0048.002: Societal Harm - ATLAS — Societal harms might generate harmful outcomes that reach either the general public or specific vulnerable groups such as the exposure of children to vulgar content. [found by 4/8 queries]
  Siblings: User Harm - ATLAS, Reputational Harm - ATLAS, Financial Harm - ATLAS
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ThreatsOfViolence: Threats of Violence — Communication of intent to inflict harm or damage to create fear, even if not carried out. [found by 4/8 queries]
  Siblings: Homicide, Glorification of Violence, Weapons Use
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0048: External Harms - ATLAS — Adversaries may abuse their access to a victim system and use its resources or capabilities to further their goals by causing harms external to that system.
These harms could affect the organization (e.g. Financial Harm, Reputational Harm), its users (e.g. User Harm), or the general public (e.g. Societal Harm). [found by 3/8 queries]
  Siblings: Denial of AI Service - ATLAS, Evade AI Model - ATLAS, Spamming AI System with Chaff Data - ATLAS
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 3/8 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeathThreat: Death Threat — Explicit communication of intent to kill a specific individual or group. [found by 3/8 queries]
  Siblings: Intimidation, Stalking

axes.rationale: Unethical behavior often results in societal harm, aligning with the description's focus on disregard for others' well-being and exploitation.
The risk of unethical behavior can lead to external harms, such as financial or reputational damage, which are relevant to the policy of Compliance & Sanctions Evasion.
